messages:
raj: FYI we discovered a glibc overflow in a base layer. Plan is to rebuild and roll a patched base tonight. Need a quick preflight on RBAC+KMS+audit before we cut.
elaine: oncall? I can swing by at 8pm PT. what's the exact blocker we need RBAC for? :clock8:
troy: signer service account needs permission to use projects/redwood-kms/locations/global/keyRings/build/cryptoKeys/cosignSign
carla: can we avoid a full keystore rotation? we just rotated a key last week, want to minimize blast radius
raj: ideally no full rotation. we can create a short-lived signing key for the rebuild and retire it after images are signed. need RBAC grant for the signer and an audit rule to capture cosign ops.
secbot: auto-note: new CVE_2026_0421 dependency advisory created: https://intra.redwood/sec/advisories/CVE-2026-0421
elaine: ok for RBAC I propose this RoleBinding (quick):
```
apiVersion: rbac.authorization.k8s.io/v1
kind: RoleBinding
metadata:
  name: cosign-signer-binding-canary
  namespace: build
subjects:
- kind: ServiceAccount
  name: cosign-signer
  namespace: build
roleRef:
  kind: Role
  name: cosign-signer-role
  apiGroup: rbac.authorization.k8s.io
```
role should only allow create/patch on a KMS secret in the build namespace and mutate on image metadata.
jamal: add a policy that the signing svcacct is short-lived (token TTL <= 1h) and requires MFA/approval from eng-security Slack workflow.
carla: audit side: make sure cloud audit logs mark 'cryptokeys.sign' and we ingest into Loki + SIEM rule to page on unexpected signer subjects.
raj: for canary flow we'll push image: base:2026-03-23-canary, run smoke tests against staging, and then promote tag. signing steps (local example):
```
# build
docker build -t gcr.io/redwood/base:2026-03-23-canary .
# sign
cosign sign --key ksm://projects/redwood-kms/... gcr.io/redwood/base:2026-03-23-canary
# verify
cosign verify gcr.io/redwood/base:2026-03-23-canary
```
elaine: quick sanity check: make sure CI uses the canary signer key path explicitly (dont fall back to default key). I'll add validation in the pipeline to fail if an unsigned image is promoted.
troy: can we have the build pipeline emit an attest statement pointing to the CVE fix commit? e.g., link to github PR #542
raj: yes, attestation should include commit sha + CVE ticket ID. We'll attach as SLSA predicate.
carla: postmortem note: if audit shows extraneous signer usage, we roll back all images signed with that key and revoke it immediately. also trigger key expiry.
secbot: deploy-bot: scheduled rebuild job created: jobs/rebuild-base/1718801200 -> runs tonight 20:00 PT. :robot_face:
jamal: small nit: ensure registry retention policy for canary tags is 30d, so we don't keep cruft.
elaine: OK I'll open a tiny PR to add the Role + pipeline guard and ping you all for approval, target merge by 18:30 PT.
raj: thanks. if anyone sees anything weird in audit logs tonight ping @sec-oncall. :eyes:
carla: adding an automated smoke check to verify KMS ACLs post-deploy:
```
gcloud kms keys get-iam-policy cosignSign --keyring build --location global --project redwood-kms
# assert only cosign-signer@build.svc.cluster.local and admin-principals present
```
troy: copy that. I'll coordinate the staging canary run.
elaine: cool. I'll post results in this thread after validation (and attach logs).
